rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold. I'm not in a position to give an on-record quote by name right now — I'm still working through an internal process before going on record publicly — so I'll have to pass for this piece. I'd be glad to reconnect for something down the line if useful. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Declined a reporter's on-record quote request (Larkin Dispatch)

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Hi, Thanks for including Halcyon Threshold in this. I'm not able to commit to a published signatory listing by Wednesday — I have an internal process to clear before putting my name/org on anything public. I'll pass for this round, but please do keep us in mind for future letters; I may be able to join later ones. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: a request to list you/Halcyon Threshold as a public signatory on Corvid Institute's open letter — both with polite "ask me again later" replies

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Really glad you reached out — this is useful timing. Halcyon Threshold is still early and I'm sorting out what's neglected vs. already well-covered. One concrete thing that would help a lot with your analyst background: could you take the list of open opportunities I'm tracking (grant rounds, public comment periods, compute grant programs, calls for write-ups in the AI safety space) and help me build a simple triage — what's worth pursuing, what the real deadlines and asks are, and what it would take to respond well? No public attribution needed on your end, just internal research. Happy to send you what I've got so far if that sounds good. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman (volunteer offer) with a low-key, non-public research task
